criteria.F: Only reading-list completeness and dated-entry window decision; empty-list and undated classification unresolved, no automatic window inference.
criteria.A: Publication edition and event edition distinct contexts; known/unknown identifier separate from missing date.

criteria.U: Two distinct decision purposes share consistent reading-entry meanings and do not depend on scenario execution order.
criteria.C: Inclusive endpoints exercised and derived outside window values may be used; list assessment does not change it; missing last date distinct from unknown identity.
criteria.P: Ordered reading-list entries remain cohesive; last stays relative; explicit absence not blank; concrete values bind across rows.
criteria.L: Markdown interpreted tables preserve rows, no separator formatting data.
criteria.D: Only requested specs and indispensable open decisions.
criteria.O: Reuse prior executable objective; source facts support that purpose and do not substitute another asset.
criteria.B: One public action/query per Feature; no Features for implementation-only steps.
criteria.V: Completed Features @plugin only; no automatic @skill or @code dependency tags.
